_doc: Guard of the 13.54 variant (DESIGN 2.7). runner/ffcore.py reads this file when FF_VARIANT=1354 (default): it refuses to run a stage of the chain that mounts a forbidden artifact or sets a forbidden environment value, sets the guard environment defaults, checks the required file hashes in every input / output artifact, and reports (warning only) stages whose code + env do not show the expected flags. lora_C1.pt: fixed hash for saved copies and modes infer / assemble, lineage check for files retrained in FF_MODE=train (file_checks[0].rule).

lora_c1.why: 13.54 uses the ORIGINAL ImageBind-audio LoRA C1 (cache-key bug: 210 MAV-Celeb clips of 70 persons, 0 VoxCeleb2 clips). The key-fixed LoRA belongs to the 16.18 system (C1FIX-01) and must not enter this chain.

required.bangla_gender_file_from: posteval_FVBIND_ENFUSE_fvb.zip (RFX' with the FVBIND B2 voice block; original LoRA C1 in its ib stream)
required.english_files: blend.py: value = FACTOR_ENFUSE English / sigma[protocol] - 1.0 * z_DP, sigma = 5.0983 (no_gender), 3.8376 (gender)
required.flags_scope: per stage, as the original runs set them (stage_env_expectations); CLEANCOMP=1 only in t112sf1s, e50cc, e112f0sx, e112f1sx (the original 112s-f0s notebook does not set it and does not mount cleancomp-e2e-p); DESIGN 4.6 row t112sf0s listing CLEANCOMP is wrong (WP-K to correct)

forbidden_artifacts.datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-c1fix-rfx-: RFX artefact relearned with the fixed LoRA (16.18)
forbidden_artifacts.datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-rf092-dev-: dev embeddings (dev data must not enter the chain; dropped from t162a's inputs)

forbidden_code_patterns.why: selects the lf (fixed LoRA) base zip in blend.py

guard_env_why: rfs_train.py of the current repository defaults to RFS_LORA_FIX=1 (fixed LoRA). The exact notebooks of the chain embed older rfs_train.py copies that do not read this variable; setting 0 is a no-op for them and protects any stage that would use a newer copy. A stage may not override it with 1 (forbidden_env).

file_checks.why: every RFX / RFX' artefact and the LoRA dataset must carry the ORIGINAL LoRA C1 (S8 K4)
file_checks.rule: FIXED sha256 for every lora_C1.pt in every mode: every C1 consumer resolves the saved original (resolve: saved_only), so RFX / RFX' made in any session carry the saved bytes. The only stage that can make a different C1 is t163l_orig (FF_MODE=train with FF_FORCE=t163l_orig, GPU, not bit-identical, DESIGN 5.1); its own output is checked by LINEAGE (made_in_session.lineage_roots: dry check ff_lora_drycheck.json = 210 clips / 70 persons / all MAV-Celeb v1, RFS_LORA_FIX never 1; new hash recorded in _DONE.json variant_lineage) and is evidence only, no consumer mounts it. Smoke artifacts are reported only. The forbidden artifacts / environment values stay refused in every mode. (19/11/2026 (integration fixer r2, INTEGRATION_r2 M3))

t163l_orig.why: the dry check (WP-F patch of t163l_orig) runs lora_data on the bundle before training: the ORIGINAL selection (cache-key bug) is 210 MAV-Celeb v1 clips of 70 persons

made_in_session.scope: only the output of the lineage root t163l_orig itself; downstream lora_C1.pt files always equal the fixed sha256 because their C1 input is saved_only (19/11/2026 (integration fixer r2, INTEGRATION_r2 M3))

stage_env_expectations._doc: Flags each stage of the original run had (DESIGN section 4 'flags' column, checked against the stage code 18/11). Looked for in stage.json env/smoke_env AND in the stage code: os.environ['K'] = 'V', os.environ.setdefault('K', 'V'), K="V" keyword (e.g. a subprocess env dict(ENVV, K="V")) or a {"K": "V"} env dict. Missing = warning, not an error.

stage_variant_field._doc: stage.json may declare "variant": {"lora_c1": ...} as free text. Accepted: a value starting with 'original' (e.g. 'original, through rfx_eval.zip of e163i'), or 'not used' / 'not_used' / 'none'. Refused: a value naming a fix variant (refuse_words, whole words for 'fix' / 'lf', substrings for the others) or any other value. `ffrun.py dag` / `plan` run this check statically over every stage.json.

notes: Three LoRA C1 variants exist: ORIGINAL (onnhqunhh/flag2027-rfs-lora-p, sha256 b97372e3..., this chain), FIX-1 (ngnnguynchn/flag2027-rfs-lorafix1-p, CELL4-01 'lf'), C1FIX-01 (ngnnguynchn/flag2027-c1fix-lora-p, system 16.18). Only the ORIGINAL is allowed here.
release/flag2027_e2e/stages.py:234-297, 318-319, 526-527 switch the chain to C1FIX; none of that is used by this repository.
sigma is not affected by the LoRA: the U table of FLAG_219 only uses the t3 / nf / nv streams (DESIGN N4).

stage_code_expectations._doc: Code that each stage must still contain (regex, multiline): the variant-defining RFS_CFG blocks of the sigma seed runs, and the dev-exclusion patches of DESIGN G11 (SPLIT_FILTER = ["train"], N_CROPS = 0, train-only index). Missing = warning: it means a stage.ipy lost a change that keeps the chain on the 13.54 variant / off the dev data.
